scope: Source implementation and isolated synthetic qualification; no live provider mutation, publication, commit, device permission or actual notification delivery.
fixes: The separate reviewed linked command binds complete provider fields and account facts; direct unprepared command submission refuses before native acceptance.
The gateway re-observes exact task/account facts before one metadata PUT; unsafe retained monthly schedules also block ordinary title-only PUTs.
Native acceptance epochs remain separate from original provider normalization; unexpected normalization is retained and explicitly conflicting.
Original Auth receipts recover lost Workspace acknowledgements; original unknown Auth attempts never gain proof from current equality.
Account changes gate private command/link previews, original receipts and cached recurring-editor identity before replacement state loads.

preservedFailures.label: components-first
